collision_acceptance.geometry_basis: The acceptance payload is uniformly scaled to 80% of the original 80x40x40 mm box while retaining 0.20 kg mass; box inertia is recomputed. Its longitudinal center limit becomes approximately +/-0.033 m. It starts at +0.031 m (2 mm clearance) moving toward the wall at 0.10 m/s. Size-only tests at mu=0.024 retained a 0-to-many collision bifurcation, so friction was increased minimally through a bounded scan; mu=0.040 is the first tested value giving C two force-bearing contacts with containment and decay.

design_basis.slow_channel: 0.6 Hz low-pass equivalent-input disturbance compensation; well below the balance-loop bandwidth
design_basis.fast_channel: 15 Hz minus 0.6 Hz complementary band from the same bounded one-step predictor innovation
design_basis.bounds: supplemental total torque is limited to 0.18 N*m (14.3% of the unchanged 1.26 N*m sum hard peak); innovation projection is separately clipped for impact robustness
design_basis.tuning_policy: single engineering-scale selection; Q/R, plant, payload, PRBS, gain bound, blend alpha, forgetting factor, and actuator limits unchanged
